record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: Let V be a connected Ad-unipotent subgroup of a Lie group G, Γ a lattice in G, and x∈G/Γ with dense Vx. For a good sequence of subsets A_n⊂V and every f∈C_c(G/Γ), do the normalized Haar averages of f(vx) over A_n converge to the Haar probability integral on G/Γ with an effective error term?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 17 (G. Margulis [174]). Show that for a “good” sequence of subsets An ⊂ V and every f ∈ Cc (G/Γ), limn→∞ 1 Vol(An) ∫ An f (v x) d v = ∫ G/Γ f d µ with effective error term, where d v is a Haar measure on V , and µ is the Haar probability measure on G/Γ.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a connected Lie group, $\Gamma\subset G$ a lattice, and $\mu$ the $G$-invariant Haar probability measure on $G/\Gamma$. Let $V\subset G$ be a connected Ad-unipotent subgroup (i.e., $\operatorname{Ad}(v)$ is a unipotent linear operator on the Lie algebra of $G$ for every $v\in V$), equipped with a Haar measure $dv$, and write $\operatorname{Vol}(A)=\int_A dv$ for measurable $A\subset V$. Fix $x\in G/\Gamma$ such that the orbit $Vx$ is dense in $G/\Gamma$.

By Ratner's theorem (in the form due to Ratner and Dani–Margulis), for any Følner-type "good" sequence of bounded measurable subsets $A_n\subset V$ with $\operatorname{Vol}(A_n)\to\infty$ and any $f\in C_c(G/\Gamma)$,
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{1}{\operatorname{Vol}(A_n)}\int_{A_n} f(vx)\,dv \;=\; \int_{G/\Gamma} f\,d\mu.$$

Problem: Establish this convergence with an effective (quantitative) error term. More precisely, identify a natural class of "good" sequences $\{A_n\}$ in $V$ (e.g., balls with respect to a fixed left-invariant Riemannian metric on $V$, or boxes in suitable coordinates), and prove that there exist constants $C=C(f,x,G,\Gamma,V)>0$ and $\delta=\delta(G,\Gamma,V)>0$ such that
$$\left|\frac{1}{\operatorname{Vol}(A_n)}\int_{A_n} f(vx)\,dv \;-\; \int_{G/\Gamma} f\,d\mu\right| \;\le\; C\,\mathcal{S}(f)\,\operatorname{Vol}(A_n)^{-\delta},$$
where $\mathcal{S}(f)$ is an appropriate Sobolev-type norm of $f$, with explicit dependence of $C$ on $x$ (for instance via the height/injectivity radius of $x$).
artifact.status_search_result: The question, posed by Margulis, is widely regarded as open in full generality. Substantial progress has been achieved in special cases: horospherical subgroups (classical, via mixing); recent work of Lindenstrauss–Mohammadi and Lindenstrauss–Mohammadi–Wang establishes polynomial effective equidistribution for one-parameter unipotent flows on quotients of SL_2(C) and SL_2(R)×SL_2(R), and more generally for rank-2 quasi-split almost simple groups, with applications to an effective Oppenheim conjecture. The general case for arbitrary Ad-unipotent V and arbitrary G, Γ remains open.

status_evidence.title: Polynomial effective equidistribution (Lindenstrauss–Mohammadi)
status_evidence.snippet: Quantitative equidistribution for orbits of one parameter unipotent groups on quotients G/Γ where G is SL_2(C) or SL_2(R)×SL_2(R) with polynomial error.
status_evidence.claim: Effective equidistribution proven in specific rank-2 cases, indicating the general Margulis question is not yet fully solved.

status_evidence.title: Effective equidistribution in rank 2 homogeneous spaces and values of quadratic forms
status_evidence.snippet: Effective equidistribution for unipotent orbits on quotients of rank-2 quasi-split almost simple groups, with effective Oppenheim applications.
status_evidence.claim: Further partial progress toward the general effective equidistribution conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Effective arguments in unipotent dynamics (Einsiedler–Mohammadi)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of effective methods in unipotent dynamics, treating the effective version of Ratner's theorems as an active research direction.
status_evidence.claim: The fully effective version of Ratner equidistribution is described as an open program.
